name: MetaMask USD
oneLiner: MetaMask USD is a Bridge-issued (Stripe) dollar stablecoin on M0 protocol, backed by short-dated U.S. T-bills and cash with on-chain Validator attestations.

sources.label: Consensys Diligence mUSD audit, sections 3 and 4 (accessed 2026-09-30)
Ethereum mUSD mToken() observation at block 26086007 (observed 2026-09-29)

dependencyReview.rationale: The audited mUSD lifecycle deposits M to mint equivalent mUSD and burns mUSD to return M through the SwapFacility. At Ethereum block 26086007, mToken() on catalog mUSD 0xaca92e438df0b2401ff60da7e4337b687a2435da returned tracked M 0x866a2bf4e572cbcf37d5071a7a58503bfb36be1b. This is the immediate serial wrapper claim; Treasury collateral belongs to the M parent. mUSD-specific proxy upgrades, pausing, account freezes, forced transfers, yield-recipient controls and approved-swapper restrictions remain local controls and are not removed by the parent mapping.

relationships.reason: Equivalent M deposit/mUSD mint and mUSD burn/M return, independently identity-pinned by mToken() at Ethereum block 26086007.

collateral: Cash and short-term U.S. Treasury securities held in bankruptcy-remote custody, issued by Bridge (a Stripe company) using the M0 protocol
pegMechanism: 1:1 mint and redemption via Bridge using M0 protocol infrastructure; reserves continuously validated on-chain by independent validators; arbitrage corrects price drift; monthly public attestations
